Input conditions / fixture: Zero submitted work orders; no assignment or audit entries.
Expected feasibility result: No work exists to schedule.
Expected solver outcome: no_work
Expected evidence status: NOT_APPLICABLE
Reason / test purpose: Empty input is not a safety pass and must not yield success or compliance percentage.
Implementation prerequisites: Current solver/API path exists; retain no-work semantics.

Input conditions / fixture: One valid work order has an allowed interval, resources, complete authenticated timetable, required possession/protection/isolation evidence, and no conflict.
Expected feasibility result: Complete modeled assignment feasible.
Expected solver outcome: success; objective proof reported separately.
Expected evidence status: PASS for every applicable predicate; NOT_APPLICABLE only for approved inapplicable rules.
Expected verification result: VERIFIED_FOR_FIXTURE only after independent verifier agrees; not an operational authorization.
Reason / test purpose: Positive control proves evidence prerequisites and solver success are separate.
Implementation prerequisites: Requires approved domain rules, provider interfaces, and test-only fixture evidence under controlled verifier tests.

Input conditions / fixture: One work order conflicts with an authoritative movement in earliest candidate interval; a later allowed interval is clear and all relevant coverage is complete.
Expected feasibility result: Feasible at later candidate only.
Expected solver outcome: success
Expected evidence status: PASS
Reason / test purpose: Tests train/maintenance interval filtering and route through dated time semantics.
Implementation prerequisites: Current same-line filter exists; authoritative dated feed and approved scope needed.

Input conditions / fixture: One required work order has no allowed interval free of authoritative train occupancy or approved possession conflict; solver completes proof.
Expected feasibility result: No complete assignment exists.
Expected solver outcome: unschedulable
Expected evidence status: PASS for complete authoritative occupancy and applicable evidence.
Reason / test purpose: Tests proven infeasibility versus timeout; all constraints and horizon must be modeled.
Implementation prerequisites: Current solver can prove only its simplified modeled instance.

Input conditions / fixture: Adversarial validator fixture supplies an assignment overlapping a validated movement on a conflicting resource.
Expected feasibility result: Assignment is infeasible and must be rejected.
Expected solver outcome: No solver output accepted; test validator rejection, not normal schedule outcome.
Expected evidence status: PASS evidence establishes the movement and conflict.
Reason / test purpose: Known violation must fail even if another check is unknown; verifier must not rely on solver claims.
Implementation prerequisites: Independent output validator and authenticated movement data.

Input conditions / fixture: Work and movement are on resources declared adjacent by versioned topology; approved activity rule says overlap conflicts; no approved protection permits coexistence.
Expected feasibility result: No overlapping assignment feasible.
Expected solver outcome: unschedulable if complete proof; otherwise search_limit_reached.
Expected evidence status: PASS topology and movement evidence.
Expected verification result: NOT_EVALUATED_NO_ASSIGNMENT; adversarial conflicting assignment is SAFETY_INVALID.
Reason / test purpose: Tests logical adjacency independently from section name or geometric nearness.
Implementation prerequisites: Topology registry and owner-approved interference matrix.

Scenario name: Heavy equipment envelope at approved boundary
Input conditions / fixture: Equipment swept envelope is exactly at owner-approved minimum separation B; same interval otherwise valid and complete evidence exists.
Expected feasibility result: Feasible if approved rule defines equality as satisfying clearance.
Expected solver outcome: success
Expected evidence status: PASS
Expected verification result: VERIFIED_FOR_FIXTURE if all other applicable checks pass.
Reason / test purpose: Boundary test without inventing a numeric distance or inclusive rule.
Implementation prerequisites: Approved equipment envelope, datum, B, precision and boundary semantics.

Scenario name: Heavy equipment envelope below approved boundary
Input conditions / fixture: Heavy equipment envelope violates owner-approved separation B during concurrent exposure.
Expected feasibility result: Assignment infeasible; verifier catches any injected invalid output.
Expected solver outcome: unschedulable if solver proves no alternative; otherwise alternate valid assignment may succeed.
Expected evidence status: PASS evidence establishes geometry and conflict.
Expected verification result: SAFETY_INVALID for conflicting output; candidate schedule unverified until resolved.
Reason / test purpose: Tests geometry-sensitive clearance rather than a blanket Boolean/time exclusion.
Implementation prerequisites: Approved geometry/threshold and independent validator.

Input conditions / fixture: Concurrent movement/work exposure applies but required footprint or chainage is absent or invalid.
Expected feasibility result: Operational feasibility cannot be established; reject or preserve as unknown per approved intake policy.
Expected solver outcome: NOT_RUN_INPUT_REJECTED or search_limit_reached only if the solver explicitly models uncertainty; never claim success as operationally feasible.
Expected evidence status: UNKNOWN
Expected verification result: SAFETY_UNVERIFIED; invalid required fields may be rejected before scheduling.
Reason / test purpose: Missing spatial evidence cannot become a pass or fabricated coordinate.
Implementation prerequisites: Input validation policy and canonical geometry contract.

Input conditions / fixture: Two simultaneous tasks require the same single-capacity crew; no alternative slot exists; all qualifications are known.
Expected feasibility result: No complete assignment under resource capacity.
Expected solver outcome: unschedulable if proven.
Expected evidence status: PASS for crew inventory/calendar and qualification records.
Reason / test purpose: Tests cumulative crew capacity rather than department label.
Implementation prerequisites: Crew IDs, capacity, availability, skill mapping, and assignment constraints.

Input conditions / fixture: A task requires credential Q, but candidate crew record is missing, expired, or unauthenticated.
Expected feasibility result: No assignment may be considered operationally feasible until evidence resolves; reject or unknown by approved policy.
Expected solver outcome: NOT_RUN_INPUT_REJECTED or search_limit_reached; not success.
Expected evidence status: UNKNOWN
Expected verification result: SAFETY_UNVERIFIED or request rejected; never verified.
Reason / test purpose: Ensures absence of certification data is not treated as qualification.
Implementation prerequisites: Credential provider, task requirement catalogue, expiry and auth semantics.

Input conditions / fixture: Two jobs simultaneously require a unique piece/type of equipment; no alternate time or compatible unit exists.
Expected feasibility result: No complete assignment under equipment capacity.
Expected solver outcome: unschedulable if proven.
Expected evidence status: PASS for complete equipment inventory and calendar.
Reason / test purpose: Tests equipment resource scheduling rather than heavy_equipment Boolean.
Implementation prerequisites: Equipment inventory, compatible type, capacity, calendar and demand fields.

Input conditions / fixture: Only available machine is not compatible with required task/equipment envelope.
Expected feasibility result: No assignment for affected order under approved compatibility policy.
Expected solver outcome: unschedulable if proven; partial if other orders can be assigned and partial output returned.
Expected evidence status: PASS for inventory and compatibility matrix.
Expected verification result: NOT_EVALUATED_NO_ASSIGNMENT for no output; partial result remains unverified unless independently checked.
Reason / test purpose: Tests typed equipment eligibility and ID accounting.
Implementation prerequisites: Approved task/equipment compatibility matrix.

Input conditions / fixture: One crew/equipment pair completes at site A; travel plus setup to site B cannot finish before B's allowed start; no other resource exists.
Expected feasibility result: No complete assignment under transition constraint.
Expected solver outcome: unschedulable if proven.
Expected evidence status: PASS for location network, travel model and setup data.
Reason / test purpose: Prevents back-to-back assignments that are temporally nonoverlapping but physically unreachable.
Implementation prerequisites: Network, resource mode, transition time, setup and location data.

Input conditions / fixture: Work order has missing, reversed, ambiguous-zone, or empty allowed interval.
Expected feasibility result: Input invalid; no assignment generated.
Expected solver outcome: NOT_RUN_INPUT_REJECTED
Expected evidence status: UNKNOWN or malformed input; not evidence pass/fail for schedule safety.
Reason / test purpose: Tests validation of dates, zones, ordering, and required fields.
Implementation prerequisites: Approved timestamp and rejection contract.

Input conditions / fixture: Work can be placed so finish is at or before an authoritative hard deadline.
Expected feasibility result: Complete feasible assignment at/before deadline.
Expected solver outcome: success
Expected evidence status: PASS for deadline source and all applicable evidence.
Reason / test purpose: Tests deadline inclusion and exact boundary under approved time precision.
Implementation prerequisites: Deadline authority, hard/soft classification, date/time semantics.

Input conditions / fixture: Every feasible placement ends after an authoritative binding deadline.
Expected feasibility result: No complete assignment for the order.
Expected solver outcome: unschedulable if proven.
Expected evidence status: PASS for deadline and constraint data.
Reason / test purpose: Tests deadline as an explicit hard constraint rather than an urgency heuristic.
Implementation prerequisites: Approved deadline semantics and time-window model.

Input conditions / fixture: Work B depends on completion of A with approved lag; solver schedules A before B and both fit.
Expected feasibility result: Complete feasible assignment.
Expected solver outcome: success
Expected evidence status: PASS for dependency graph and source state.
Expected verification result: VERIFIED_FOR_FIXTURE if all safety evidence passes.
Reason / test purpose: Tests precedence relation and lag application.
Implementation prerequisites: Dependency schema and approved lag/waiver semantics.

Input conditions / fixture: Work-order dependency graph has a cycle or references an unknown order.
Expected feasibility result: Invalid request or unschedulable model according to approved cycle policy; no silent edge drop.
Expected solver outcome: NOT_RUN_INPUT_REJECTED preferred for malformed graph.
Expected evidence status: UNKNOWN or invalid input.
Reason / test purpose: Tests graph validation and no silent deletion of dependency constraints.
Implementation prerequisites: Canonical dependency contract and cycle policy.

Input conditions / fixture: Candidate assignment would exceed approved rolling duty or violate minimum rest based on authenticated prior work history.
Expected feasibility result: Candidate is infeasible; alternative may be scheduled if available.
Expected solver outcome: success on alternative, else unschedulable if proven.
Expected evidence status: PASS for complete roster/history and current policy.
Expected verification result: VERIFIED_FOR_FIXTURE only for valid alternative; invalid assignment is SAFETY_INVALID or rejected.
Reason / test purpose: Tests real duty data, not objective 8-hour bins.
Implementation prerequisites: Approved workforce policy, history horizon and crew calendar.

Input conditions / fixture: Solver proposes a time interval but no authoritative operational possession/closure is granted for the exact assets and interval.
Expected feasibility result: Solver candidate may satisfy encoded model, but cannot be operationally released.
Expected solver outcome: success may describe model feasibility only; final verification remains independent.
Expected evidence status: UNKNOWN
Reason / test purpose: A planned interval is not a granted possession.
Implementation prerequisites: Possession authority, evidence scope/state and API separation.

Input conditions / fixture: Traction activity has no isolation record, or only caller Boolean/source text is supplied.
Expected feasibility result: No verified operational assignment; scheduling candidate status must not imply isolation.
Expected solver outcome: success only as an unverified solver candidate if model permits; otherwise reject until evidence.
Expected evidence status: UNKNOWN
Reason / test purpose: Tests spoofed/absent evidence and fail-closed provider behavior.
Implementation prerequisites: Authenticated electrical/isolation provider and approved applicability rules.

Input conditions / fixture: Authoritative evidence for applicable activity says required isolation is absent/denied for interval.
Expected feasibility result: Assignment violates hard prerequisite; do not release or present as verified.
Expected solver outcome: No assignment should be approved; unschedulable only if model includes the denial and proves no alternate interval.
Expected evidence status: FAIL
Expected verification result: SAFETY_INVALID for an attempted assignment; otherwise no schedule verification.
Reason / test purpose: Known failure takes precedence over other unknown checks.
Implementation prerequisites: Authenticated negative-state semantics and recheck on time changes.

Input conditions / fixture: Only a partial movement list exists or provider coverage excludes part of assignment interval/track.
Expected feasibility result: Candidate solver may find a model-feasible slot, but no operational clearance conclusion is possible.
Expected solver outcome: success may only mean modeled candidate; proof of operational feasibility unavailable.
Expected evidence status: UNKNOWN
Reason / test purpose: No listed conflict does not prove no train exists.
Implementation prerequisites: Completeness attestation with coverage scope, date, version and freshness.

Input conditions / fixture: Caller supplies TimetableCoverage with trusted-looking source string but no authenticated provider assertion.
Expected feasibility result: No complete-evidence pass; solver may return candidate only.
Expected solver outcome: success may only mean modeled candidate; never verified from label.
Expected evidence status: UNKNOWN
Reason / test purpose: Tests that source labels and allowlists are not authentication.
Implementation prerequisites: Real provider authentication; current base provider correctly authenticates nothing.

Input conditions / fixture: Previously authenticated timetable version is expired, superseded, or has a missed update sequence before work interval.
Expected feasibility result: Existing schedule is invalidated for relevant interval; regenerate/check with current version.
Expected solver outcome: No current solver outcome until re-evaluated; old result must not remain current success.
Expected evidence status: UNKNOWN or explicit invalidation state.
Reason / test purpose: Tests freshness, update gap, and schedule invalidation.
Implementation prerequisites: Provider lifecycle and approved freshness/change policy.

Input conditions / fixture: Three valid orders compete for capacity allowing exactly two; solver proves maximum coverage under the modeled instance.
Expected feasibility result: Feasible partial assignment; one ID omitted exactly once.
Expected solver outcome: partial; `maximum_coverage_proven=true` in separate proof metadata.
Expected evidence status: PASS for all applicable evidence in returned assignments.
Expected verification result: Verification assessed per scheduled assignments; unscheduled order is not verified as completed.
Reason / test purpose: Tests coverage status separate from proof and complete ID accounting.
Implementation prerequisites: Canonical partial/proof semantics and independent validator.

Input conditions / fixture: Solver finds an incumbent but computational limit prevents proof of complete feasibility/maximum coverage/objective optimum as configured.
Expected feasibility result: Feasible incumbent may be returned but completeness/optimality proof remains unknown.
Expected solver outcome: partial if some-but-not-all assigned, or success only if complete feasibility is established; termination/proof metadata says search_limit_reached/unknown.
Expected evidence status: UNKNOWN where verification evidence incomplete; solver cutoff itself is not safety evidence.
Expected verification result: Safety state independently PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN; never infer unschedulable from cutoff.
Reason / test purpose: Tests limit versus infeasibility and incumbent versus proof.
Implementation prerequisites: Consistent proof/termination response model.

Input conditions / fixture: Two submitted work orders have the same ID.
Expected feasibility result: Reject input before scheduling.
Expected solver outcome: NOT_RUN_INPUT_REJECTED
Expected evidence status: NOT_APPLICABLE; no schedule evidence.
Reason / test purpose: Prevents ambiguous accounting and evidence binding.
Implementation prerequisites: Current code rejects duplicate IDs; preserve this invariant.

Input conditions / fixture: Two distinct tasks on same approved site/window have explicit bilateral eligibility, sufficient resources, and valid shared possession/protection.
Expected feasibility result: Feasible only if every hard shared-resource condition is satisfied.
Expected solver outcome: success if complete feasible assignment proven.
Expected evidence status: PASS for eligibility, shared-resource, and safety evidence.
Reason / test purpose: Tests co-location as approved eligibility, not merely equal intervals or department labels.
Implementation prerequisites: Owner-approved compatibility matrix and resource model.

Input conditions / fixture: Tasks overlap and either activity disallows co-location or shared resources/protection are insufficient.
Expected feasibility result: Overlap infeasible; seek separate times or partial result.
Expected solver outcome: success on valid separation, partial, or unschedulable according to proof.
Expected evidence status: PASS for policy establishing prohibition; evidence for any alternative checked independently.
Expected verification result: SAFETY_INVALID for injected prohibited overlap; otherwise independently verify alternative.
Reason / test purpose: Tests bilateral permission and no reward overriding hard incompatibility.
Implementation prerequisites: Approved co-location policy.

Input conditions / fixture: Two assets are geographically close but not logically adjacent, or topology says shared/coupled despite non-nearest geometry.
Expected feasibility result: Outcome follows owner-approved topology/affected-resource rule, not raw distance alone.
Expected solver outcome: success only if all mapped resource constraints satisfy policy; otherwise proven outcome as configured.
Expected evidence status: PASS topology evidence required; UNKNOWN without valid topology version.
Expected verification result: SAFETY_UNVERIFIED if relevant topology is missing or stale.
Reason / test purpose: Separates logical adjacency graph from physical-distance calculations.
Implementation prerequisites: Versioned infrastructure graph and approved conflict mapping.

Input conditions / fixture: Solver output duplicates a scheduled ID, omits an ID from both lists, includes unknown ID, or counts disagree.
Expected feasibility result: Invalid solver response; discard rather than report success.
Expected solver outcome: No accepted outcome; validation error.
Expected evidence status: NOT_APPLICABLE to evidence status; independent validation fails.
Reason / test purpose: Tests duplicate-free disjoint partition and response count consistency.
Implementation prerequisites: Independent output validator/API invariant.

Input conditions / fixture: A new authoritative movement/update changes occupancy within a scheduled work interval or invalidates coverage evidence.
Expected feasibility result: Prior schedule no longer has current feasibility proof; re-evaluation required.
Expected solver outcome: Prior solver outcome marked stale/invalidated; no continued current success.
Expected evidence status: UNKNOWN until rechecked; FAIL if validated new movement conflicts.
Expected verification result: SAFETY_UNVERIFIED or SAFETY_INVALID after revalidation, per evidence.
Reason / test purpose: Tests lifecycle invalidation, not merely initial solve.
Implementation prerequisites: Version digests, update stream, impact analysis and operations response policy.
